select primary_key, CONCAT_WS('-', product_part_sign, NULLIF(model, '')) product_Info, primary_key product_Code from ${dynamicTableNameProxy.productPart} a where exists (select 1 from ${dynamicTableNameProxy.productPartRouteRelationshipModel} b where a.primary_key = b.product_part_code
and b.enterprise_code = ${dynamicTableNameProxy.enterpriseCode} and b.delete_flag = false and exists (select 1 from (SELECT ttdmprd.primary_key, CAST(TRIM(BOTH ' ' FROM elem) as bigint) AS procedure_data_value -- 清理空格 FROM ${dynamicTableNameProxy.processRouteDataModel} ttdmprd
CROSS JOIN LATERAL UNNEST( STRING_TO_ARRAY( REPLACE(REPLACE(ttdmprd.procedure_data, '[', ''), ']', ''), -- 移除方括号 ',' -- 按逗号分割 ) ) AS elem where ttdmprd.primary_key =b.process_route_data_code and ttdmprd.enterprise_code = ${dynamicTableNameProxy.enterpriseCode} and ttdmprd.delete_flag = false) c, ${dynamicTableNameProxy.productPartProcedure} d where c.procedure_data_value = d.primary_key and d.enterprise_code = ${dynamicTableNameProxy.enterpriseCode} and d.delete_flag = false and d.nature = 310920141775044609))
and a.enterprise_code = ${dynamicTableNameProxy.enterpriseCode} and a.delete_flag = false and a.attribute = 1
and ( ${dynamicTableNameProxy.getProductPartKeywordCondition("a.primary_key",data.keyWord)} )
